body:
Founder tested S459-65's threshold fix: 'yea i etsted it its possible its a little better not sure not fixed'. Real structural gap found: NetPlayer (wire packet) never carries velocity or grounded state, only position -- client reconciliation resets p->x/y/z from the server every time but never touches p->vy, so jump-arc replay kept simulating from whatever locally-predicted velocity the client already had, silently diverging from the real server velocity with nothing to correct it. Fixed by re-seeding p->vx/vy/vz from a real finite-difference estimate between two confirmed authoritative positions (using the client's own recorded cmd timestamps), reset on connect/respawn. apps/lobby builds clean, no new warnings. Fresh Windows client built. Commit 7e88bdd.

⚓ ☃
title: S459-67: fixed residual jump rubberbanding -- reconciliation never corrected velocity, only position
